premises.text: Stores use fast, opaque dynamic and personalized pricing that disadvantages consumers
premises.evidence_span: stores are taking advantage of this psychology by changing prices, by getting you to pay more without you realizing it

premises.text: Price-drop guarantees exist but filing claims is such a hassle that almost nobody recovers the money, leaving billions unclaimed
premises.evidence_span: it's a huge hassle. Not only are the policies often complex by design, it takes a ton of time to price compare

premises.text: Paribus scans email receipts, tracks post-purchase prices, and automatically files claims when prices drop
premises.evidence_span: It scans your inbox for receipts, tracks the prices on what you bought, and when they drop, automatically files claims to get you paid

premises.text: Paribus earns only after saving the user money, taking a standard 25% fee that referrals can reduce to zero
premises.evidence_span: The only time that Paribus earns is after we save you money first. Our standard fee is charged 25% of the money we earn you

value.text: Get consumers the money they are owed from price drops effortlessly
value.evidence_span: gets you the money you're owed effortlessly

secondary_value.text: Restore integrity of prices so consumers need not constantly price-compare
secondary_value.evidence_span: When you can trust the integrity of prices, you no longer need a price compare

causal_links.evidence_span: online consumers are leaving $10 billion on the table every year
